pokemon.name: bulbasaur
pokemon.flavorText: A strange seed was planted on its back at birth. The plant sprouts and grows with this POKéMON.

pokemon.name: ivysaur
pokemon.flavorText: When the bulb on its back grows large, it appears to lose the ability to stand on its hind legs.

pokemon.name: venusaur
pokemon.flavorText: The plant blooms when it is absorbing solar energy. It stays on the move to seek sunlight.

pokemon.name: charmander
pokemon.flavorText: Obviously prefers hot places. When it rains, steam is said to spout from the tip of its tail.

pokemon.name: charmeleon
pokemon.flavorText: When it swings its burning tail, it elevates the temperature to unbearably high levels.

pokemon.name: charizard
pokemon.flavorText: Spits fire that is hot enough to melt boulders. Known to cause forest fires unintentionally.

pokemon.name: squirtle
pokemon.flavorText: After birth, its back swells and hardens into a shell. Powerfully sprays foam from its mouth.

pokemon.name: wartortle
pokemon.flavorText: Often hides in water to stalk unwary prey. For swimming fast, it moves its ears to maintain balance.

pokemon.name: blastoise
pokemon.flavorText: A brutal POKéMON with pressurized water jets on its shell. They are used for high speed tackles.

pokemon.name: caterpie
pokemon.flavorText: Its short feet are tipped with suction pads that enable it to tirelessly climb slopes and walls.

pokemon.name: metapod
pokemon.flavorText: This POKéMON is vulnerable to attack while its shell is soft, exposing its weak and tender body.

pokemon.name: butterfree
pokemon.flavorText: In battle, it flaps its wings at high speed to release highly toxic dust into the air.

pokemon.name: weedle
pokemon.flavorText: Often found in forests, eating leaves. It has a sharp venomous stinger on its head.

pokemon.name: kakuna
pokemon.flavorText: Almost incapable of moving, this POKéMON can only harden its shell to protect itself from predators.

pokemon.name: beedrill
pokemon.flavorText: Flies at high speed and attacks using its large venomous stingers on its forelegs and tail.

pokemon.name: pidgey
pokemon.flavorText: A common sight in forests and woods. It flaps its wings at ground level to kick up blinding sand.

pokemon.name: pidgeotto
pokemon.flavorText: Very protective of its sprawling territorial area, this POKéMON will fiercely peck at any intruder.

pokemon.name: pidgeot
pokemon.flavorText: When hunting, it skims the surface of water at high speed to pick off unwary prey such as MAGIKARP.

pokemon.name: rattata
pokemon.flavorText: Bites anything when it attacks. Small and very quick, it is a common sight in many places.

pokemon.name: raticate
pokemon.flavorText: It uses its whis­ kers to maintain its balance. It apparently slows down if they are cut off.

pokemon.name: spearow
pokemon.flavorText: Eats bugs in grassy areas. It has to flap its short wings at high speed to stay airborne.

pokemon.name: fearow
pokemon.flavorText: With its huge and magnificent wings, it can keep aloft without ever having to land for rest.

pokemon.name: ekans
pokemon.flavorText: Moves silently and stealthily. Eats the eggs of birds, such as PIDGEY and SPEAROW, whole.

pokemon.name: arbok
pokemon.flavorText: It is rumored that the ferocious warning markings on its belly differ from area to area.

pokemon.name: pikachu
pokemon.flavorText: When several of these POKéMON gather, their electricity could build and cause lightning storms.

pokemon.name: raichu
pokemon.flavorText: Its long tail serves as a ground to protect itself from its own high voltage power.

pokemon.name: sandshrew
pokemon.flavorText: Burrows deep underground in arid locations far from water. It only emerges to hunt for food.

pokemon.name: sandslash
pokemon.flavorText: Curls up into a spiny ball when threatened. It can roll while curled up to attack or escape.

pokemon.name: nidoran-f
pokemon.flavorText: Although small, its venomous barbs render this POKéMON dangerous. The female has smaller horns.

pokemon.name: nidorina
pokemon.flavorText: The female's horn develops slowly. Prefers physical attacks such as clawing and biting.

pokemon.name: nidoqueen
pokemon.flavorText: Its hard scales provide strong protection. It uses its hefty bulk to execute powerful moves.

pokemon.name: nidoran-m
pokemon.flavorText: Stiffens its ears to sense danger. The larger its horns, the more powerful its secreted venom.

pokemon.name: nidorino
pokemon.flavorText: An aggressive POKéMON that is quick to attack. The horn on its head secretes a powerful venom.

pokemon.name: nidoking
pokemon.flavorText: It uses its powerful tail in battle to smash, constrict, then break the prey's bones.

pokemon.name: clefairy
pokemon.flavorText: Its magical and cute appeal has many admirers. It is rare and found only in certain areas.

pokemon.name: clefable
pokemon.flavorText: A timid fairy POKéMON that is rarely seen. It will run and hide the moment it senses people.

pokemon.name: vulpix
pokemon.flavorText: At the time of birth, it has just one tail. The tail splits from its tip as it grows older.

pokemon.name: ninetales
pokemon.flavorText: Very smart and very vengeful. Grabbing one of its many tails could result in a 1000-year curse.

pokemon.name: jigglypuff
pokemon.flavorText: When its huge eyes light up, it sings a mysteriously soothing melody that lulls its enemies to sleep.

pokemon.name: wigglytuff
pokemon.flavorText: The body is soft and rubbery. When angered, it will suck in air and inflate itself to an enormous size.

pokemon.name: zubat
pokemon.flavorText: Forms colonies in perpetually dark places. Uses ultrasonic waves to identify and approach targets.

pokemon.name: golbat
pokemon.flavorText: Once it strikes, it will not stop draining energy from the victim even if it gets too heavy to fly.

pokemon.name: oddish
pokemon.flavorText: During the day, it keeps its face buried in the ground. At night, it wanders around sowing its seeds.

pokemon.name: gloom
pokemon.flavorText: The fluid that oozes from its mouth isn't drool. It is a nectar that is used to attract prey.

pokemon.name: vileplume
pokemon.flavorText: The larger its petals, the more toxic pollen it contains. Its big head is heavy and hard to hold up.

pokemon.name: paras
pokemon.flavorText: Burrows to suck tree roots. The mushrooms on its back grow by draw­ ing nutrients from the bug host.

pokemon.name: parasect
pokemon.flavorText: A host-parasite pair in which the parasite mushroom has taken over the host bug. Prefers damp places.

pokemon.name: venonat
pokemon.flavorText: Lives in the shadows of tall trees where it eats insects. It is attracted by light at night.

pokemon.name: venomoth
pokemon.flavorText: The dust-like scales covering its wings are color coded to indicate the kinds of poison it has.

pokemon.name: diglett
pokemon.flavorText: Lives about one yard underground where it feeds on plant roots. It sometimes appears above ground.

pokemon.name: dugtrio
pokemon.flavorText: A team of DIGLETT triplets. It triggers huge earthquakes by burrowing 60 miles underground.

pokemon.name: meowth
pokemon.flavorText: Adores circular objects. Wanders the streets on a nightly basis to look for dropped loose change.

pokemon.name: persian
pokemon.flavorText: Although its fur has many admirers, it is tough to raise as a pet because of its fickle meanness.

pokemon.name: psyduck
pokemon.flavorText: While lulling its enemies with its vacant look, this wily POKéMON will use psychokinetic powers.

pokemon.name: golduck
pokemon.flavorText: Often seen swim­ ming elegantly by lake shores. It is often mistaken for the Japanese monster, Kappa.

pokemon.name: mankey
pokemon.flavorText: Extremely quick to anger. It could be docile one moment then thrashing away the next instant.

pokemon.name: primeape
pokemon.flavorText: Always furious and tenacious to boot. It will not abandon chasing its quarry until it is caught.

pokemon.name: growlithe
pokemon.flavorText: Very protective of its territory. It will bark and bite to repel intruders from its space.

pokemon.name: arcanine
pokemon.flavorText: A POKéMON that has been admired since the past for its beauty. It runs agilely as if on wings.

pokemon.name: poliwag
pokemon.flavorText: Its newly grown legs prevent it from running. It appears to prefer swimming than trying to stand.

pokemon.name: poliwhirl
pokemon.flavorText: Capable of living in or out of water. When out of water, it sweats to keep its body slimy.

pokemon.name: poliwrath
pokemon.flavorText: An adept swimmer at both the front crawl and breast stroke. Easily overtakes the best human swimmers.

pokemon.name: abra
pokemon.flavorText: Using its ability to read minds, it will identify impending danger and TELEPORT to safety.

pokemon.name: kadabra
pokemon.flavorText: It emits special alpha waves from its body that induce headaches just by being close by.

pokemon.name: alakazam
pokemon.flavorText: Its brain can out­ perform a super­ computer. Its intelligence quotient is said to be 5,000.

pokemon.name: machop
pokemon.flavorText: Loves to build its muscles. It trains in all styles of martial arts to become even stronger.

pokemon.name: machoke
pokemon.flavorText: Its muscular body is so powerful, it must wear a power save belt to be able to regulate its motions.

pokemon.name: machamp
pokemon.flavorText: Using its heavy muscles, it throws powerful punches that can send the victim clear over the horizon.

pokemon.name: bellsprout
pokemon.flavorText: A carnivorous POKéMON that traps and eats bugs. It uses its root feet to soak up needed moisture.

pokemon.name: weepinbell
pokemon.flavorText: It spits out POISONPOWDER to immobilize the enemy and then finishes it with a spray of ACID.

pokemon.name: victreebel
pokemon.flavorText: Said to live in huge colonies deep in jungles, although no one has ever returned from there.

pokemon.name: tentacool
pokemon.flavorText: Drifts in shallow seas. Anglers who hook them by accident are often punished by its stinging acid.

pokemon.name: tentacruel
pokemon.flavorText: The tentacles are normally kept short. On hunts, they are extended to ensnare and immobilize prey.

pokemon.name: geodude
pokemon.flavorText: Found in fields and mountains. Mistaking them for boulders, people often step or trip on them.

pokemon.name: graveler
pokemon.flavorText: Rolls down slopes to move. It rolls over any obstacle without slowing or changing its direction.

pokemon.name: golem
pokemon.flavorText: Its boulder-like body is extremely hard. It can easily withstand dynamite blasts without damage.

pokemon.name: ponyta
pokemon.flavorText: Its hooves are 10 times harder than diamonds. It can trample anything completely flat in little time.

pokemon.name: rapidash
pokemon.flavorText: Very competitive, this POKéMON will chase anything that moves fast in the hopes of racing it.

pokemon.name: slowpoke
pokemon.flavorText: Incredibly slow and dopey. It takes 5 seconds for it to feel pain when under attack.

pokemon.name: slowbro
pokemon.flavorText: The SHELLDER that is latched onto SLOWPOKE's tail is said to feed on the host's left over scraps.

pokemon.name: magnemite
pokemon.flavorText: Uses anti-gravity to stay suspended. Appears without warning and uses THUNDER WAVE and similar moves.

pokemon.name: magneton
pokemon.flavorText: Formed by several MAGNEMITEs linked together. They frequently appear when sunspots flare up.

pokemon.name: farfetchd
pokemon.flavorText: The sprig of green onions it holds is its weapon. It is used much like a metal sword.

pokemon.name: doduo
pokemon.flavorText: A bird that makes up for its poor flying with its fast foot speed. Leaves giant footprints.

pokemon.name: dodrio
pokemon.flavorText: Uses its three brains to execute complex plans. While two heads sleep, one head stays awake.

pokemon.name: seel
pokemon.flavorText: The protruding horn on its head is very hard. It is used for bashing through thick ice.

pokemon.name: dewgong
pokemon.flavorText: Stores thermal energy in its body. Swims at a steady 8 knots even in intensely cold waters.

pokemon.name: grimer
pokemon.flavorText: Appears in filthy areas. Thrives by sucking up polluted sludge that is pumped out of factories.

pokemon.name: muk
pokemon.flavorText: Thickly covered with a filthy, vile sludge. It is so toxic, even its footprints contain poison.

pokemon.name: shellder
pokemon.flavorText: Its hard shell repels any kind of attack. It is vulnerable only when its shell is open.

pokemon.name: cloyster
pokemon.flavorText: When attacked, it launches its horns in quick volleys. Its innards have never been seen.

pokemon.name: gastly
pokemon.flavorText: Almost invisible, this gaseous POKéMON cloaks the target and puts it to sleep without notice.

pokemon.name: haunter
pokemon.flavorText: Because of its ability to slip through block walls, it is said to be from an­ other dimension.

pokemon.name: gengar
pokemon.flavorText: Under a full moon, this POKéMON likes to mimic the shadows of people and laugh at their fright.

pokemon.name: onix
pokemon.flavorText: As it grows, the stone portions of its body harden to become similar to a diamond, but colored black.

pokemon.name: drowzee
pokemon.flavorText: Puts enemies to sleep then eats their dreams. Occasionally gets sick from eating bad dreams.

pokemon.name: hypno
pokemon.flavorText: When it locks eyes with an enemy, it will use a mix of PSI moves such as HYPNOSIS and CONFUSION.

pokemon.name: krabby
pokemon.flavorText: Its pincers are not only powerful weapons, they are used for balance when walking sideways.

pokemon.name: kingler
pokemon.flavorText: The large pincer has 10000 hp of crushing power. However, its huge size makes it unwieldy to use.

pokemon.name: voltorb
pokemon.flavorText: Usually found in power plants. Easily mistaken for a POKé BALL, they have zapped many people.

pokemon.name: electrode
pokemon.flavorText: It stores electric energy under very high pressure. It often explodes with little or no provocation.

pokemon.name: exeggcute
pokemon.flavorText: Often mistaken for eggs. When disturbed, they quickly gather and attack in swarms.

pokemon.name: exeggutor
pokemon.flavorText: Legend has it that on rare occasions, one of its heads will drop off and continue on as an EXEGGCUTE.

pokemon.name: cubone
pokemon.flavorText: Because it never removes its skull helmet, no one has ever seen this POKéMON's real face.

pokemon.name: marowak
pokemon.flavorText: The bone it holds is its key weapon. It throws the bone skillfully like a boomerang to KO targets.

pokemon.name: hitmonlee
pokemon.flavorText: When in a hurry, its legs lengthen progressively. It runs smoothly with extra long, loping strides.

pokemon.name: hitmonchan
pokemon.flavorText: While apparently doing nothing, it fires punches in lightning fast volleys that are impossible to see.

pokemon.name: lickitung
pokemon.flavorText: Its tongue can be extended like a chameleon's. It leaves a tingling sensation when it licks enemies.

pokemon.name: koffing
pokemon.flavorText: Because it stores several kinds of toxic gases in its body, it is prone to exploding without warning.

pokemon.name: weezing
pokemon.flavorText: Where two kinds of poison gases meet, 2 KOFFINGs can fuse into a WEEZING over many years.

pokemon.name: rhyhorn
pokemon.flavorText: Its massive bones are 1000 times harder than human bones. It can easily knock a trailer flying.

pokemon.name: rhydon
pokemon.flavorText: Protected by an armor-like hide, it is capable of living in molten lava of 3,600 degrees.

pokemon.name: chansey
pokemon.flavorText: A rare and elusive POKéMON that is said to bring happiness to those who manage to get it.

pokemon.name: tangela
pokemon.flavorText: The whole body is swathed with wide vines that are similar to sea­ weed. Its vines shake as it walks.

pokemon.name: kangaskhan
pokemon.flavorText: The infant rarely ventures out of its mother's protective pouch until it is 3 years old.

pokemon.name: horsea
pokemon.flavorText: Known to shoot down flying bugs with precision blasts of ink from the surface of the water.

pokemon.name: seadra
pokemon.flavorText: Capable of swim­ ming backwards by rapidly flapping its wing-like pectoral fins and stout tail.

pokemon.name: goldeen
pokemon.flavorText: Its tail fin billows like an elegant ballroom dress, giving it the nickname of the Water Queen.

pokemon.name: seaking
pokemon.flavorText: In the autumn spawning season, they can be seen swimming power­ fully up rivers and creeks.

pokemon.name: staryu
pokemon.flavorText: An enigmatic POKéMON that can effortlessly regenerate any appendage it loses in battle.

pokemon.name: starmie
pokemon.flavorText: Its central core glows with the seven colors of the rainbow. Some people value the core as a gem.

pokemon.name: mr-mime
pokemon.flavorText: If interrupted while it is miming, it will slap around the offender with its broad hands.

pokemon.name: scyther
pokemon.flavorText: With ninja-like agility and speed, it can create the illusion that there is more than one.

pokemon.name: jynx
pokemon.flavorText: It seductively wiggles its hips as it walks. It can cause people to dance in unison with it.

pokemon.name: electabuzz
pokemon.flavorText: Normally found near power plants, they can wander away and cause major blackouts in cities.

pokemon.name: magmar
pokemon.flavorText: Its body always burns with an orange glow that enables it to hide perfectly among flames.

pokemon.name: pinsir
pokemon.flavorText: If it fails to crush the victim in its pincers, it will swing it around and toss it hard.

pokemon.name: tauros
pokemon.flavorText: When it targets an enemy, it charges furiously while whipping its body with its long tails.

pokemon.name: magikarp
pokemon.flavorText: In the distant past, it was somewhat stronger than the horribly weak descendants that exist today.

pokemon.name: gyarados
pokemon.flavorText: Rarely seen in the wild. Huge and vicious, it is capable of destroying entire cities in a rage.

pokemon.name: lapras
pokemon.flavorText: A POKéMON that has been over­ hunted almost to extinction. It can ferry people across the water.

pokemon.name: ditto
pokemon.flavorText: Capable of copying an enemy's genetic code to instantly transform itself into a duplicate of the enemy.

pokemon.name: eevee
pokemon.flavorText: Its genetic code is irregular. It may mutate if it is exposed to radiation from element STONEs.

pokemon.name: vaporeon
pokemon.flavorText: Lives close to water. Its long tail is ridged with a fin which is often mistaken for a mermaid's.

pokemon.name: jolteon
pokemon.flavorText: It accumulates negative ions in the atmosphere to blast out 10000- volt lightning bolts.

pokemon.name: flareon
pokemon.flavorText: When storing thermal energy in its body, its temperature could soar to over 1600 degrees.

pokemon.name: porygon
pokemon.flavorText: A POKéMON that consists entirely of programming code. Capable of moving freely in cyberspace.

pokemon.name: omanyte
pokemon.flavorText: Although long extinct, in rare cases, it can be genetically resurrected from fossils.

pokemon.name: omastar
pokemon.flavorText: A prehistoric POKéMON that died out when its heavy shell made it impossible to catch prey.

pokemon.name: kabuto
pokemon.flavorText: A POKéMON that was resurrected from a fossil found in what was once the ocean floor eons ago.

pokemon.name: kabutops
pokemon.flavorText: Its sleek shape is perfect for swim­ ming. It slashes prey with its claws and drains the body fluids.

pokemon.name: aerodactyl
pokemon.flavorText: A ferocious, pre­ historic POKéMON that goes for the enemy's throat with its serrated saw-like fangs.

pokemon.name: snorlax
pokemon.flavorText: Very lazy. Just eats and sleeps. As its rotund bulk builds, it becomes steadily more slothful.

pokemon.name: articuno
pokemon.flavorText: A legendary bird POKéMON that is said to appear to doomed people who are lost in icy mountains.

pokemon.name: zapdos
pokemon.flavorText: A legendary bird POKéMON that is said to appear from clouds while dropping enormous lightning bolts.

pokemon.name: moltres
pokemon.flavorText: Known as the legendary bird of fire. Every flap of its wings creates a dazzling flash of flames.

pokemon.name: dratini
pokemon.flavorText: Long considered a mythical POKéMON until recently when a small colony was found living underwater.

pokemon.name: dragonair
pokemon.flavorText: A mystical POKéMON that exudes a gentle aura. Has the ability to change climate conditions.

pokemon.name: dragonite
pokemon.flavorText: An extremely rarely seen marine POKéMON. Its intelligence is said to match that of humans.

pokemon.name: mewtwo
pokemon.flavorText: It was created by a scientist after years of horrific gene splicing and DNA engineering experiments.

pokemon.name: mew
pokemon.flavorText: So rare that it is still said to be a mirage by many experts. Only a few people have seen it worldwide.
